title: Mork & Mindy white egg as a hint of hidden knowledge

tellings.quote: The story goes and they show it in the preview of that show and it's part of every show is this white egg. He flew to Earth

plain: The white egg-shaped craft that Robin Williams's alien character flies to Earth in on the 1970s TV sitcom Mork & Mindy is said to be a hint of hidden knowledge about real UFOs. Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he helped recover a UFO, tells Michels this as a story that gets passed around, noting that the egg is in the show's preview and "part of every show." If true, people in television were dropping clues about real craft into a popular comedy.
